summary: Produced the backend design artefact for OBS-02 Prometheus metrics at src/design/obs-02-prometheus-metrics.md. The artefact defines module boundaries, metric registry lifecycle, GET /metrics response contract, exact required metric families/labels, histogram bucket strategy supporting p50/p95/p99, instrumentation points for HTTP/event append/DB/task completion, cardinality controls, non-blocking scrape guarantees, DB-outage stale-data behavior, and full traceability mapping for all OBS-02 acceptance criteria and edge cases.

tests_run.name: design completeness and traceability review
tests_run.detail: Verified that every OBS-02 acceptance criterion and edge case maps to explicit design sections and testable behaviors.
